name: Shin Hwa Dynamics Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1956 and based in Ansan, South Korea, Shin Hwa Dynamics Co., Ltd. specializes in the production and global distribution of tin plates. Their electrolytic tinplate steel sheets serve as a crucial material across numerous applications, including the manufacturing of beverage cans, food containers, paint and oil receptacles, medicine packaging, dry battery casings, and bottle crowns. The company transitioned to its current name, Shin Hwa Dynamics Co., Ltd., in July 2021, having previously operated as Shin Hwa Sil Up Co.,Ltd.
